title: Kubeflow Notebook Servers
summary: A collection of Dockerfiles for Kubeflow notebook server images, based on kubeflow/kubeflow's example-notebook-servers and customized for the author's own use case. The sdv package is listed as a pinned dependency in the Python and Python-R notebook server requirements files but is not called anywhere in the evidence.
needs: No code matched SDV usage patterns; sdv is only a pinned dependency in requirements.txt, so actual usage cannot be confirmed.
